cli.intro: OpenCFD — create, edit, solve and export two-dimensional incompressible cases.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create the default lid-driven cavity case
cmd.mesh-set: Set the structured mesh of an existing case
cmd.fluid-set: Set density and dynamic viscosity of an existing case
cmd.time-set: Set time step, step count, pressure sweeps and tolerance
cmd.boundary-set: Set one boundary kind and velocity of an existing case
cmd.boundary-list: Print the four side boundary conditions and inlet profiles
cmd.boundary-reset: Reset one side or every side to a stationary wall
cmd.obstacle-update: Replace one solid obstacle in place, keeping its id and order
cmd.obstacle-remove: Remove one solid obstacle by id
cmd.porous-add: Add an isotropic Darcy–Forchheimer porous region
cmd.porous-list: Print the porous regions in document order
cmd.porous-remove: Remove one porous region by id
cmd.probe-update: Move one point monitor to a new position
cmd.probe-remove: Remove one point monitor by id
cmd.thermal-set: Configure energy-equation boundaries, heat source and reference temperature
cmd.wall-function-set: Evaluate the reported wall shear with the log law
cmd.reynolds: Report the derived Reynolds number of an existing case
cmd.stability: Report the explicit time-step stability limits without solving
cmd.solve: Solve a case and print the report
cmd.export: Solve a case and write CSV, VTK, SVG, a line profile or field statistics

opt.nx: Number of cells in x (at least 3)
opt.ny: Number of cells in y (at least 3)
opt.length-x: Domain length in x, in metres
opt.length-y: Domain length in y, in metres
opt.mu: Dynamic viscosity in Pa.s; 0 means inviscid
opt.steps: Number of time steps to advance
opt.pressure-iterations: Maximum pressure SOR sweeps per time step
opt.side: Domain side: left, right, top or bottom
opt.kind: Boundary kind: wall, inlet or outlet
opt.id: Stable identifier of an obstacle or point monitor
opt.x: Point or circle centre in x, in metres
opt.y: Point or circle centre in y, in metres
opt.rotation: Counter-clockwise rectangle rotation about its centroid in degrees
opt.permeability: Porous permeability K in m2; must be positive
opt.inertial: Forchheimer inertial coefficient C_F; non-negative, default 0
opt.specific-heat: Specific heat capacity cp in J/(kg·K); default 1
opt.conductivity: Thermal conductivity k in W/(m·K); omitted derives it from the diffusivity
opt.diffusivity: Scalar or thermal diffusivity in m2/s
opt.heat-source: Uniform volumetric heat source in W/m3
opt.left-heat-flux: Heat flux into the fluid on the left side, in W/m2
opt.right-heat-flux: Heat flux into the fluid on the right side, in W/m2
opt.top-heat-flux: Heat flux into the fluid on the top side, in W/m2
opt.bottom-heat-flux: Heat flux into the fluid on the bottom side, in W/m2
opt.obstacle-temperature: Fixed temperature of every obstacle surface in K
opt.obstacle-heat-flux: Heat flux from every obstacle surface into the fluid, in W/m2
opt.reference-temperature: Reference temperature for the Nusselt number in K
opt.min-y-plus: y+ below which the viscous sublayer estimate is used; default 11.06
opt.format: Export format: csv, vtk, svg, contours, streamlines, residuals, forces, coefficients, probes, particles, profile or statistics
opt.line: Profile segment as x0,y0,x1,y1 in metres
opt.samples: Number of equally spaced profile samples (at least 2, default 101)
